gear-weapon#0223.dst: Esta varinha se funde a quem a toca, causando mudanças horríveis. Unhas compridas, dentes afiados e a capacidade de cuspir fogo são as marcas da fera.
gear-weapon#0223.flat: This wand merges with the user on touch, bringing about horrific changes to them. Elongated nails, sharp teeth and the ability to breathe fire are trademarks of the beast.

gear-weapon#0224.src: One of many lost artifacts from the legendary Wind Fortress, the engraving appears to be a cryptic clue to where the Fortress fell. "We shall be found among the dark winds of the morrow."
gear-weapon#0224.dst: Um dos muitos artefatos perdidos da lendária Fortaleza do Vento; a gravação parece ser uma pista enigmática de onde a Fortaleza caiu. "Seremos encontrados entre os ventos sombrios do amanhã."
gear-weapon#0224.flat: One of many lost artifacts from the legendary Wind Fortress, the engraving appears to be a cryptic clue to where the Fortress fell. "We shall be found among the dark winds of the morrow."

gear-weapon#0225.src: The world revolves around you, after all. It's high time you spread the news!
gear-weapon#0225.dst: Afinal, o mundo gira ao seu redor. Já passou da hora de espalhar a notícia!
gear-weapon#0225.flat: The world revolves around you, after all. It's high time you spread the news!

gear-weapon#0226.src: A year-long monsoon soaked this {p}-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.
gear-weapon#0226.dst: Uma monção que durou um ano inteiro encharcou tanto este arco feito em {p} que ele absorveu a própria essência da água.
gear-weapon#0226.flat: A year-long monsoon soaked this {p}-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.
gear-weapon#0226._raw: A year-long monsoon soaked this Nemract-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.

gear-weapon#0227.src: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and immense wisdom meld to create a commanding aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for dominion over all.
gear-weapon#0227.dst: O poder combinado das runas Uth inscritas e de uma sabedoria imensa se funde numa aura imponente, pois esta arma não passa de uma extensão espiritual do desejo do usuário de dominar tudo.
gear-weapon#0227.flat: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and immense wisdom meld to create a commanding aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for dominion over all.

gear-weapon#0228.src: A string so subtle it can slip by the walls of reality, bringing its targets into the space beyond space itself.
gear-weapon#0228.dst: Uma corda tão sutil que passa pelas paredes da realidade, levando seus alvos ao espaço além do próprio espaço.
gear-weapon#0228.flat: A string so subtle it can slip by the walls of reality, bringing its targets into the space beyond space itself.

gear-weapon#0229.src: A bow drawn from the air itself. It imbues the wielder with all the spirit of the wind.
gear-weapon#0229.dst: Um arco extraído do próprio ar. Ele infunde no portador todo o espírito do vento.
gear-weapon#0229.flat: A bow drawn from the air itself. It imbues the wielder with all the spirit of the wind.

gear-weapon#0230.src: The diminutive stature of this item belies its abilities. Absorbing and expelling magical energy in precise bursts, it protects the user from all manner of attacks while punishing those who dare strike.
gear-weapon#0230.dst: O tamanho diminuto deste item esconde suas habilidades. Absorvendo e expelindo energia mágica em rajadas precisas, ele protege o usuário de todo tipo de ataque enquanto pune quem ousa golpear.
gear-weapon#0230.flat: The diminutive stature of this item belies its abilities. Absorbing and expelling magical energy in precise bursts, it protects the user from all manner of attacks while punishing those who dare strike.

gear-weapon#0231.src: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the {p}, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.
gear-weapon#0231.dst: Este kris sacrificial, caído do pico de {p}, é completamente oco. Empunhá-lo é convidar o mesmo vazio para dentro de si. Tornar-se tal aberração, apagar a si mesmo em busca de poder... ele precisa se alimentar do portador até que reste apenas a mais tênue existência.
gear-weapon#0231.flat: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the {p}, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.
gear-weapon#0231._raw: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the Tower of Ascension, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.

gear-weapon#0232.src: This ornate knife, which fell from {p} centuries ago, is still followed by the shadows of the void, blotting out the sun in a wide area around it. Bathed in the darkness of twilight, you finally feel truly liberated, as no soul will ever see the horrors you commit.
gear-weapon#0232.dst: Esta faca ornamentada, que caiu de {p} há séculos, ainda é seguida pelas sombras do vazio, que encobrem o sol numa grande área ao redor. Banhado na escuridão do crepúsculo, você finalmente se sente livre de verdade, pois nenhuma alma jamais verá os horrores que você comete.
gear-weapon#0232.flat: This ornate knife, which fell from {p} centuries ago, is still followed by the shadows of the void, blotting out the sun in a wide area around it. Bathed in the darkness of twilight, you finally feel truly liberated, as no soul will ever see the horrors you commit.
gear-weapon#0232._raw: This ornate knife, which fell from Ahmsord centuries ago, is still followed by the shadows of the void, blotting out the sun in a wide area around it. Bathed in the darkness of twilight, you finally feel truly liberated, as no soul will ever see the horrors you commit.

gear-weapon#0233.src: "If anyone finds this, leave it at my Gale's gravesite. I promised her a memento, too." This inscription is extremely weathered.
gear-weapon#0233.dst: "Se alguém encontrar isto, deixe no túmulo da minha Gale. Prometi uma lembrança a ela também." Esta inscrição está extremamente desgastada.
gear-weapon#0233.flat: "If anyone finds this, leave it at my Gale's gravesite. I promised her a memento, too." This inscription is extremely weathered.

gear-weapon#0234.src: This expertly crafted bow was whittled by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its frame was cut from the very toughest tree roots.
gear-weapon#0234.dst: Este arco de excelente feitura foi entalhado por um fanático pesquisador de criptídeos. Sua estrutura foi cortada das raízes de árvore mais resistentes.
gear-weapon#0234.flat: This expertly crafted bow was whittled by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its frame was cut from the very toughest tree roots.

gear-weapon#0235.src: This expertly crafted dagger was smithed by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It can chop through even the thickest of the swamp's clay with ease.
gear-weapon#0235.dst: Esta adaga de excelente feitura foi forjada por um fanático pesquisador de criptídeos. Ela corta com facilidade até a argila mais grossa do pântano.
gear-weapon#0235.flat: This expertly crafted dagger was smithed by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It can chop through even the thickest of the swamp's clay with ease.

gear-weapon#0236.src: This expertly crafted relik was notched by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its feathers and baubles chime with a soothing melody.
gear-weapon#0236.dst: Este relik de excelente feitura foi talhado por um fanático pesquisador de criptídeos. Suas penas e berloques tilintam numa melodia relaxante.
gear-weapon#0236.flat: This expertly crafted relik was notched by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its feathers and baubles chime with a soothing melody.

gear-weapon#0237.src: This expertly crafted spear was forged by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shines brilliantly in even the weakest sunlight.
gear-weapon#0237.dst: Esta lança de excelente feitura foi forjada por um fanático pesquisador de criptídeos. Ela brilha intensamente até sob a luz do sol mais fraca.
gear-weapon#0237.flat: This expertly crafted spear was forged by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shines brilliantly in even the weakest sunlight.

gear-weapon#0238.src: This expertly crafted wand was shaped by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shimmers with the purest water from the swamp.
gear-weapon#0238.dst: Esta varinha de excelente feitura foi moldada por um fanático pesquisador de criptídeos. Ela cintila com a água mais pura do pântano.
gear-weapon#0238.flat: This expertly crafted wand was shaped by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shimmers with the purest water from the swamp.

gear-weapon#0239.src: Everything dies. Show those who resist the foolishness of their ambitions.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0239.dst: Tudo morre. Mostre a quem resiste a tolice de suas ambições.Está puxando em direção a algo.
gear-weapon#0239.flat: Everything dies. Show those who resist the foolishness of their ambitions.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0240.src: True artistry takes time... with the power to sculpt mountains and erode cliffsides into panoramas, the beliefs of your enemies are insignificant. They will understand your greatness... in due time.
gear-weapon#0240.dst: A verdadeira arte leva tempo... com o poder de esculpir montanhas e erodir encostas até virarem panoramas, as crenças dos seus inimigos são insignificantes. Eles vão entender sua grandeza... no devido tempo.
gear-weapon#0240.flat: True artistry takes time... with the power to sculpt mountains and erode cliffsides into panoramas, the beliefs of your enemies are insignificant. They will understand your greatness... in due time.

gear-weapon#0241.src: Holding this relik sends sparks through your veins, making your heart beat fast. And faster. And faster and faster and--
gear-weapon#0241.dst: Segurar este relik manda faíscas pelas suas veias, fazendo seu coração bater rápido. E mais rápido. E mais e mais rápido e--
gear-weapon#0241.flat: Holding this relik sends sparks through your veins, making your heart beat fast. And faster. And faster and faster and--

gear-weapon#0243.src: They must know what you went through. They must suffer the same as you did.
gear-weapon#0243.dst: Eles precisam saber o que você passou. Precisam sofrer o mesmo que você sofreu.
gear-weapon#0243.flat: They must know what you went through. They must suffer the same as you did.

gear-weapon#0244.src: Faces have danced around you as long as you can remember, laughing, jeering, mocking. This is your surrender, casting faces of your own into the theatre of your humiliation.
gear-weapon#0244.dst: Rostos dançam ao seu redor desde que você se lembra, rindo, vaiando, zombando. Esta é a sua rendição: lançar rostos seus no teatro da sua humilhação.
gear-weapon#0244.flat: Faces have danced around you as long as you can remember, laughing, jeering, mocking. This is your surrender, casting faces of your own into the theatre of your humiliation.

gear-weapon#0245.src: "I am only human in the snow. When it melts away, so too do I, for then I am cursed to be a swan."
gear-weapon#0245.dst: "Só sou humana na neve. Quando ela derrete, eu também me vou, pois então estou amaldiçoada a ser um cisne."
gear-weapon#0245.flat: "I am only human in the snow. When it melts away, so too do I, for then I am cursed to be a swan."

gear-weapon#0246.src: The song of the world begins as a quiet whistle, calm and peaceful, wrapping 'round the trees and drifting lazily across the fields. It is ever so soft, yet sharper than any sword.
gear-weapon#0246.dst: A canção do mundo começa como um assobio baixo, calmo e sereno, envolvendo as árvores e flutuando preguiçosa pelos campos. É suavíssima, mas mais afiada que qualquer espada.
gear-weapon#0246.flat: The song of the world begins as a quiet whistle, calm and peaceful, wrapping 'round the trees and drifting lazily across the fields. It is ever so soft, yet sharper than any sword.

gear-weapon#0247.src: Her crimes were against Decency. She laughed and spat, denying reason and making the world suffer for small vengeance.
gear-weapon#0247.dst: Os crimes dela foram contra a Decência. Ela ria e cuspia, negando a razão e fazendo o mundo sofrer por pequenas vinganças.
gear-weapon#0247.flat: Her crimes were against Decency. She laughed and spat, denying reason and making the world suffer for small vengeance.

gear-weapon#0248.src: The magically rejuvenating properties of phoenix ash were imbued into this grand stave in its creator's bid to gain immortality.
gear-weapon#0248.dst: As propriedades magicamente rejuvenescedoras das cinzas de fênix foram infundidas neste grande bordão na tentativa de seu criador de alcançar a imortalidade.
gear-weapon#0248.flat: The magically rejuvenating properties of phoenix ash were imbued into this grand stave in its creator's bid to gain immortality.

gear-weapon#0249.src: Carried by the {p} Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.
gear-weapon#0249.dst: Carregado pelo Médico da Peste de {p}, este graveto de aparência simples verte sutilmente uma substância não identificada que revigora quem o segura e é letalmente venenosa para todo o resto.
gear-weapon#0249.flat: Carried by the {p} Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.
gear-weapon#0249._raw: Carried by the Olux Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.

gear-weapon#0250.src: With each swing, this ornate hammer threatens to shape mountains and carve valleys, cleaving new fault lines in a single blow.
gear-weapon#0250.dst: A cada golpe, este martelo ornamentado ameaça moldar montanhas e esculpir vales, abrindo novas falhas num só golpe.
gear-weapon#0250.flat: With each swing, this ornate hammer threatens to shape mountains and carve valleys, cleaving new fault lines in a single blow.

gear-weapon#0251.src: Wielding this molten sword, you feel your worries and empathy combust away into corrosive smoke. If one can feel so free, why should it matter if it comes to the detriment of the world around you?
gear-weapon#0251.dst: Empunhando esta espada derretida, você sente suas preocupações e sua empatia virarem fumaça corrosiva. Se é possível se sentir tão livre, que importa se isso prejudica o mundo ao seu redor?
gear-weapon#0251.flat: Wielding this molten sword, you feel your worries and empathy combust away into corrosive smoke. If one can feel so free, why should it matter if it comes to the detriment of the world around you?

gear-weapon#0253.src: This spear is bright enough that it can cause blindness if you look directly at it. Its immense power is limited by its weight; the weapon is nearly impossible to lift.
gear-weapon#0253.dst: Esta lança é tão brilhante que pode causar cegueira se você olhar diretamente para ela. Seu poder imenso é limitado pelo peso; é quase impossível levantar a arma.
gear-weapon#0253.flat: This spear is bright enough that it can cause blindness if you look directly at it. Its immense power is limited by its weight; the weapon is nearly impossible to lift.

gear-weapon#0254.src: This staff was expertly crafted from fragile spun glass, and tinted with various magical foci that bend light into its most raw components.
gear-weapon#0254.dst: Este cajado foi feito com maestria de frágil vidro fiado, e tingido com vários focos mágicos que decompõem a luz em seus componentes mais puros.
gear-weapon#0254.flat: This staff was expertly crafted from fragile spun glass, and tinted with various magical foci that bend light into its most raw components.

gear-weapon#0255.src: The density of this weapon is almost immeasurable. Despite being light and easy to wield, the spear seems to have its own gravitational pull, slowly dragging enemies closer and making it nearly impossible to put down.
gear-weapon#0255.dst: A densidade desta arma é quase incomensurável. Apesar de leve e fácil de empunhar, a lança parece ter a própria atração gravitacional, puxando os inimigos aos poucos e sendo quase impossível de largar.
gear-weapon#0255.flat: The density of this weapon is almost immeasurable. Despite being light and easy to wield, the spear seems to have its own gravitational pull, slowly dragging enemies closer and making it nearly impossible to put down.

gear-weapon#0256.src: "Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, {p} Sewer Dweller
gear-weapon#0256.dst: "Deixem a gente aqui embaixo para morrer, por que não? Transformem a gente em mais uma estatística e pronto, né?" -Ragamal, morador dos esgotos de {p}
gear-weapon#0256.flat: "Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, {p} Sewer Dweller
gear-weapon#0256._raw: "Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, Nemract Sewer Dweller

gear-weapon#0257.src: "I always thought Yahya was venom-addled, but the symptoms don't match..." -Pyeka, Alekin Herbalist
gear-weapon#0257.dst: "Sempre achei que Yahya estava perturbado pelo veneno, mas os sintomas não batem..." -Pyeka, herborista de Alekin
gear-weapon#0257.flat: "I always thought Yahya was venom-addled, but the symptoms don't match..." -Pyeka, Alekin Herbalist

gear-weapon#0258.src: The great serpent of Ahms was said to be a bringer of wisdom in days long past, revered by the inhabitants of the region. Totems like this one were crafted as an act of worship, though as belief faded over time, so too were these idols lost and destroyed. Only one remains.
gear-weapon#0258.dst: Dizia-se que a grande serpente de Ahms trazia sabedoria em tempos remotos, venerada pelos habitantes da região. Totens como este eram talhados como ato de adoração, mas, à medida que a fé se apagou com o tempo, esses ídolos também se perderam e foram destruídos. Só resta um.
gear-weapon#0258.flat: The great serpent of Ahms was said to be a bringer of wisdom in days long past, revered by the inhabitants of the region. Totems like this one were crafted as an act of worship, though as belief faded over time, so too were these idols lost and destroyed. Only one remains.

gear-weapon#0259.src: A spear hewn from a radioactive metal. It may be toxic for the wielder, but it is fatal to its enemies.
gear-weapon#0259.dst: Uma lança talhada de um metal radioativo. Pode ser tóxica para o portador, mas é fatal para os inimigos.
gear-weapon#0259.flat: A spear hewn from a radioactive metal. It may be toxic for the wielder, but it is fatal to its enemies.

gear-weapon#0260.src: A grave digger uncovered this blade from the resting place of a notorious pirate that pillaged the islands of the ocean for four decades.
gear-weapon#0260.dst: Um coveiro desenterrou esta lâmina do túmulo de um pirata infame que saqueou as ilhas do oceano por quatro décadas.
gear-weapon#0260.flat: A grave digger uncovered this blade from the resting place of a notorious pirate that pillaged the islands of the ocean for four decades.

gear-weapon#0261.src: To call an end a new beginning implies there ever was a beginning, or ever will be an end.
gear-weapon#0261.dst: Chamar um fim de novo começo pressupõe que já houve um começo, ou que um dia haverá um fim.
gear-weapon#0261.flat: To call an end a new beginning implies there ever was a beginning, or ever will be an end.

gear-weapon#0262.src: The flickering flame atop this simple wand is a marvel of magic. It always burns at a comfortable heat, cannot scorch skin even if touched, and never can be snuffed out under any circumstance.
gear-weapon#0262.dst: A chama tremeluzente no topo desta varinha simples é uma maravilha da magia. Ela sempre arde num calor agradável, não queima a pele nem se for tocada e nunca pode ser apagada, aconteça o que acontecer.
gear-weapon#0262.flat: The flickering flame atop this simple wand is a marvel of magic. It always burns at a comfortable heat, cannot scorch skin even if touched, and never can be snuffed out under any circumstance.

gear-weapon#0263.src: Finally, the pulse of melody and harmony flies through golden halls, flung by the momentum of life itself. A single knock of polished wood on chiselled stone, and the song of the world falls silent.
gear-weapon#0263.dst: Por fim, o pulso da melodia e da harmonia voa por salões dourados, lançado pelo ímpeto da própria vida. Uma única batida de madeira polida em pedra cinzelada, e a canção do mundo silencia.
gear-weapon#0263.flat: Finally, the pulse of melody and harmony flies through golden halls, flung by the momentum of life itself. A single knock of polished wood on chiselled stone, and the song of the world falls silent.

gear-weapon#0264.src: Despite being proven unrelated, this enigmatic bow was the lynchpin to beginning the great search for the Relics.
gear-weapon#0264.dst: Embora se tenha provado que não tinha relação, este arco enigmático foi a peça-chave para começar a grande busca pelas Relíquias.
gear-weapon#0264.flat: Despite being proven unrelated, this enigmatic bow was the lynchpin to beginning the great search for the Relics.

gear-weapon#0265.src: Despite this mace never seeing use by Remikas, it was seen as a symbol of the might of his rule over Gavel. Its true abilities in battle have never been seen.
gear-weapon#0265.dst: Embora Remikas nunca tenha usado esta maça, ela era vista como símbolo do poder de seu reinado sobre Gavel. Suas verdadeiras capacidades em batalha nunca foram vistas.
gear-weapon#0265.flat: Despite this mace never seeing use by Remikas, it was seen as a symbol of the might of his rule over Gavel. Its true abilities in battle have never been seen.

gear-weapon#0266.src: "Skin worked so thin, we see the bone; she grinds us up from on her throne. Their houses made of flimsy steel; scars from bombs will never heal."
gear-weapon#0266.dst: "Pele tão gasta que se vê o osso; ela nos tritura lá do trono. As casas deles, de aço frágil; as cicatrizes das bombas nunca vão sarar."
gear-weapon#0266.flat: "Skin worked so thin, we see the bone; she grinds us up from on her throne. Their houses made of flimsy steel; scars from bombs will never heal."

gear-weapon#0267.src: Her crimes were against the State. She burned and pillaged, making a mockery of law and civility throughout the land.
gear-weapon#0267.dst: Os crimes dela foram contra o Estado. Ela queimou e saqueou, zombando da lei e da civilidade por toda a terra.
gear-weapon#0267.flat: Her crimes were against the State. She burned and pillaged, making a mockery of law and civility throughout the land.

gear-weapon#0268.src: The power to join oneself with the lifeblood of the earth has long eluded sects of fanatical druids and shamans. One such cult found a way, and subsequently wiped itself out in the process, their flesh turning to stone and veins forming new rivers.
gear-weapon#0268.dst: O poder de se unir ao sangue vital da terra há muito escapa a seitas de druidas e xamãs fanáticos. Um desses cultos encontrou um jeito, e em seguida se aniquilou no processo: a carne deles virou pedra e as veias formaram novos rios.
gear-weapon#0268.flat: The power to join oneself with the lifeblood of the earth has long eluded sects of fanatical druids and shamans. One such cult found a way, and subsequently wiped itself out in the process, their flesh turning to stone and veins forming new rivers.

gear-weapon#0270.src: Many old mages had to perform lengthy incantations to make potent even their simplest spells. A mage cursed to be mute, however, brought upon a revolution to spellcasting through this simple wand.
gear-weapon#0270.dst: Muitos magos antigos tinham que recitar longos encantamentos para dar potência até aos feitiços mais simples. Um mago amaldiçoado com a mudez, porém, revolucionou o lançamento de feitiços com esta varinha simples.
gear-weapon#0270.flat: Many old mages had to perform lengthy incantations to make potent even their simplest spells. A mage cursed to be mute, however, brought upon a revolution to spellcasting through this simple wand.

gear-weapon#0271.src: There was glory in this place, once. Life, vitality, springing forth from every well and boulder. No longer. All that remains now is death, and a fleeting memory of that which once was.
gear-weapon#0271.dst: Já houve glória neste lugar. Vida, vitalidade, brotando de cada poço e cada pedra. Não mais. Tudo o que resta agora é a morte, e uma lembrança fugaz do que um dia foi.
gear-weapon#0271.flat: There was glory in this place, once. Life, vitality, springing forth from every well and boulder. No longer. All that remains now is death, and a fleeting memory of that which once was.

gear-weapon#0272.src: This enigmatic weapon can suddenly blink out of reality with no warning only to appear exactly where it was left later. Artificers have determined that almost the entire bow, by all known laws of nature and magic, should not exist.
gear-weapon#0272.dst: Esta arma enigmática pode sumir da realidade de repente, sem aviso, só para reaparecer mais tarde exatamente onde foi deixada. Artífices concluíram que quase todo o arco, por todas as leis conhecidas da natureza e da magia, não deveria existir.
gear-weapon#0272.flat: This enigmatic weapon can suddenly blink out of reality with no warning only to appear exactly where it was left later. Artificers have determined that almost the entire bow, by all known laws of nature and magic, should not exist.

gear-weapon#0273.src: A boiling rage has been gathering, the pain of an entire empire yearning to be freed. With all the power of the downtrodden and the overlooked and the starved, you echo out a shout with ten thousand voices, each too quiet to hear by itself, but together a catastrophic force to make the heavens cower.
gear-weapon#0273.dst: Uma raiva fervente vem se acumulando, a dor de um império inteiro ansiando por liberdade. Com todo o poder dos oprimidos, dos esquecidos e dos famintos, você solta um grito com dez mil vozes, cada uma baixa demais para ser ouvida sozinha, mas juntas uma força catastrófica que faz os céus se encolherem.
gear-weapon#0273.flat: A boiling rage has been gathering, the pain of an entire empire yearning to be freed. With all the power of the downtrodden and the overlooked and the starved, you echo out a shout with ten thousand voices, each too quiet to hear by itself, but together a catastrophic force to make the heavens cower.

gear-weapon#0274.src: Time moves in strange ways around this translucent blade, speeding and slowing, starting and stopping, with no observable reasoning or pattern.
gear-weapon#0274.dst: O tempo se move de forma estranha em volta desta lâmina translúcida, acelerando e desacelerando, começando e parando, sem nenhuma lógica ou padrão observável.
gear-weapon#0274.flat: Time moves in strange ways around this translucent blade, speeding and slowing, starting and stopping, with no observable reasoning or pattern.

gear-weapon#0275.src: The world suffocates under pressure, the seasons decay under age. The rivers dry up and the oceans flood the land while you helplessly watch your friends drop like flies.
gear-weapon#0275.dst: O mundo sufoca sob pressão, as estações apodrecem com a idade. Os rios secam e os oceanos inundam a terra enquanto você assiste, impotente, seus amigos caírem como moscas.
gear-weapon#0275.flat: The world suffocates under pressure, the seasons decay under age. The rivers dry up and the oceans flood the land while you helplessly watch your friends drop like flies.

gear-weapon#0276.src: After this crossbow's original wielder fell in battle, its mechanisms stiffened and locked into place. A spark of life, or undeath, can temporarily reverse the effect before the weapon seizes up again.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0276.dst: Depois que o primeiro portador desta besta caiu em batalha, seus mecanismos endureceram e travaram. Uma faísca de vida, ou de morte-vida, pode reverter o efeito por um tempo antes que a arma trave de novo.Está puxando em direção a algo.
gear-weapon#0276.flat: After this crossbow's original wielder fell in battle, its mechanisms stiffened and locked into place. A spark of life, or undeath, can temporarily reverse the effect before the weapon seizes up again.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0277.src: Named for an ancient Wynnic word for "Earthquake", this mighty battle hammer causes the very bones of struck enemies to rattle and heave as though the earth itself was splitting under their feet.
gear-weapon#0277.dst: Batizado com uma antiga palavra wynnesa para "Terremoto", este poderoso martelo de batalha faz os próprios ossos dos inimigos atingidos chacoalharem e se agitarem como se a terra se partisse sob seus pés.
gear-weapon#0277.flat: Named for an ancient Wynnic word for "Earthquake", this mighty battle hammer causes the very bones of struck enemies to rattle and heave as though the earth itself was splitting under their feet.

gear-weapon#0278.src: The waves are not like men; they do not brazenly assault and catastrophically fail. They do not burn fast and wink out. They bide their time, they wait, and they encroach upon the world with an insidious, unstoppable force, dragging you away to the dark side of the sea.
gear-weapon#0278.dst: As ondas não são como os homens; elas não atacam com descaramento para fracassar de forma catastrófica. Não ardem depressa para se apagar num piscar. Elas esperam a hora certa, aguardam e avançam sobre o mundo com uma força insidiosa e imparável, arrastando você para o lado sombrio do mar.
gear-weapon#0278.flat: The waves are not like men; they do not brazenly assault and catastrophically fail. They do not burn fast and wink out. They bide their time, they wait, and they encroach upon the world with an insidious, unstoppable force, dragging you away to the dark side of the sea.

gear-weapon#0279.src: Not knowing what's going on is the best part!
gear-weapon#0279.dst: Não saber o que está acontecendo é a melhor parte!
gear-weapon#0279.flat: Not knowing what's going on is the best part!

gear-weapon#0280.src: The first of her crimes was against the Church. She blasphemed and raved, cursing with the names of gods long-abandoned.
gear-weapon#0280.dst: O primeiro de seus crimes foi contra a Igreja. Ela blasfemou e delirou, praguejando com os nomes de deuses há muito abandonados.
gear-weapon#0280.flat: The first of her crimes was against the Church. She blasphemed and raved, cursing with the names of gods long-abandoned.

gear-weapon#0281.src: Discipline and experience is channeled into these wands for {~} years in the Bantisu monastery of the canyon, in the hope that they will pass on its teachings to less experienced users.
gear-weapon#0281.dst: Disciplina e experiência são canalizadas nestas varinhas por {~} anos no mosteiro Bantisu do cânion, na esperança de que elas transmitam seus ensinamentos a usuários menos experientes.
gear-weapon#0281.flat: Discipline and experience is channeled into these wands for {~} years in the Bantisu monastery of the canyon, in the hope that they will pass on its teachings to less experienced users.
gear-weapon#0281._raw: Discipline and experience is channeled into these wands for 10 years in the Bantisu monastery of the canyon, in the hope that they will pass on its teachings to less experienced users.

gear-weapon#0282.src: "Can anyone else understand that General Graken? Because I can't." -Commander Takan, {p} Militia
gear-weapon#0282.dst: "Mais alguém entende esse General Graken? Porque eu não." -Comandante Takan, Milícia de {p}
gear-weapon#0282.flat: "Can anyone else understand that General Graken? Because I can't." -Commander Takan, {p} Militia
gear-weapon#0282._raw: "Can anyone else understand that General Graken? Because I can't." -Commander Takan, Nemract Militia

gear-weapon#0283.src: The whispers crescendo to cackles, creeping cries clouding your mind. You can't think. They eat away at the edges of your consciousness. You can't think. It's too loud in your brain. You can't think.
gear-weapon#0283.dst: Os sussurros crescem até virar gargalhadas, gritos rastejantes que nublam sua mente. Você não consegue pensar. Eles roem as bordas da sua consciência. Você não consegue pensar. Está barulhento demais na sua cabeça. Você não consegue pensar.
gear-weapon#0283.flat: The whispers crescendo to cackles, creeping cries clouding your mind. You can't think. They eat away at the edges of your consciousness. You can't think. It's too loud in your brain. You can't think.

gear-weapon#0284.src: This dagger has no blade. Instead, it is layered with the stingers of the Black Shadow Scorpion, which has the ability to vanish entirely from its prey.
gear-weapon#0284.dst: Esta adaga não tem lâmina. Em vez disso, é revestida de ferrões do Escorpião da Sombra Negra, que consegue sumir por completo diante da presa.
gear-weapon#0284.flat: This dagger has no blade. Instead, it is layered with the stingers of the Black Shadow Scorpion, which has the ability to vanish entirely from its prey.

gear-weapon#0285.src: The melody hardens, groaning and clanking, a clash of iron on steel and a shout from a thousand trampled mouths in unison. It burns and breaks, a roar of unbridled power.
gear-weapon#0285.dst: A melodia endurece, gemendo e retinindo, um choque de ferro contra aço e um grito em uníssono de mil bocas pisoteadas. Ela arde e quebra, um rugido de poder desenfreado.
gear-weapon#0285.flat: The melody hardens, groaning and clanking, a clash of iron on steel and a shout from a thousand trampled mouths in unison. It burns and breaks, a roar of unbridled power.

gear-weapon#0286.src: Ooze secretes out of every inch of this quarterstaff. Is it simply just more of the slime harassing travelers in the jungle, or is there something sinister at play?It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0286.dst: Gosma escorre de cada centímetro deste bastão. É só mais da gosma que importuna os viajantes na selva, ou há algo sinistro em jogo?Está puxando em direção a algo.
gear-weapon#0286.flat: Ooze secretes out of every inch of this quarterstaff. Is it simply just more of the slime harassing travelers in the jungle, or is there something sinister at play?It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0287.src: A psychopath claiming herself to be Death incarnate used this dark-bladed scythe on a killing spree that lasted over a year. It reaped hundreds of lives, including her own.
gear-weapon#0287.dst: Uma psicopata que dizia ser a Morte encarnada usou esta foice de lâmina escura numa onda de assassinatos que durou mais de um ano. Ela ceifou centenas de vidas, inclusive a dela.
gear-weapon#0287.flat: A psychopath claiming herself to be Death incarnate used this dark-bladed scythe on a killing spree that lasted over a year. It reaped hundreds of lives, including her own.

gear-weapon#0288.src: The light refracted through this sceptre shows you visions. You see the endless waves reflected in its rainbows, cracking hulls and drowning towns. This prism allows you to channel a fraction of the sea's potential.
gear-weapon#0288.dst: A luz refratada por este cetro mostra visões. Você vê as ondas sem fim refletidas em seus arco-íris, partindo cascos e afogando cidades. Este prisma permite canalizar uma fração do potencial do mar.
gear-weapon#0288.flat: The light refracted through this sceptre shows you visions. You see the endless waves reflected in its rainbows, cracking hulls and drowning towns. This prism allows you to channel a fraction of the sea's potential.

gear-weapon#0289.src: "I bet those sewer-dwellers have horrible morning breath." -Folzoy, {p} Escort
gear-weapon#0289.dst: "Aposto que esses moradores dos esgotos têm um bafo matinal horrível." -Folzoy, escolta de {p}
gear-weapon#0289.flat: "I bet those sewer-dwellers have horrible morning breath." -Folzoy, {p} Escort
gear-weapon#0289._raw: "I bet those sewer-dwellers have horrible morning breath." -Folzoy, Maltic Escort

gear-weapon#0290.src: What chaos is born when the sun won't rise, as it lacks a sky upon which to dawn?
gear-weapon#0290.dst: Que caos nasce quando o sol não nasce, por lhe faltar um céu onde raiar?
gear-weapon#0290.flat: What chaos is born when the sun won't rise, as it lacks a sky upon which to dawn?

gear-weapon#0291.src: The radiance of your foes burns bright. You must emanate your brilliance in return. Cloak them in a blinding glow. Smother their luminance with yours. Then after all of their light has faded, yours will too.
gear-weapon#0291.dst: O esplendor dos seus inimigos arde forte. Você precisa irradiar seu brilho em resposta. Envolva-os num clarão ofuscante. Sufoque a luz deles com a sua. Depois que toda a luz deles se apagar, a sua também se apagará.
gear-weapon#0291.flat: The radiance of your foes burns bright. You must emanate your brilliance in return. Cloak them in a blinding glow. Smother their luminance with yours. Then after all of their light has faded, yours will too.

gear-weapon#0292.src: There's a scrawling etched onto the handle: "UNGA BUNGA'S. NO TOUCH."
gear-weapon#0292.dst: Há um rabisco gravado no cabo: "DE UNGA BUNGA. NÃO MEXER."
gear-weapon#0292.flat: There's a scrawling etched onto the handle: "UNGA BUNGA'S. NO TOUCH."

gear-weapon#0293.src: An effigy built from the stones of the mantle. It crushes anything in its wake.
gear-weapon#0293.dst: Uma efígie construída com as pedras do manto. Ela esmaga tudo o que encontra pelo caminho.
gear-weapon#0293.flat: An effigy built from the stones of the mantle. It crushes anything in its wake.

gear-weapon#0294.src: "Cut a web, and its owner will feel it and come out. That's your chance to strike." -Lieutenant Van, {p} {~}nd Regiment
gear-weapon#0294.dst: "Corte uma teia, e a dona vai sentir e sair. É a sua chance de atacar." -Tenente Van, {~}º Regimento de {p}
gear-weapon#0294.flat: "Cut a web, and its owner will feel it and come out. That's your chance to strike." -Lieutenant Van, {p} {~}nd Regiment
gear-weapon#0294._raw: "Cut a web, and its owner will feel it and come out. That's your chance to strike." -Lieutenant Van, Detlas 2nd Regiment

gear-weapon#0295.src: Wielding it for too long will leave one a desiccated husk, as this dull blade slowly absorbs all liquids around it.
gear-weapon#0295.dst: Empunhá-la por tempo demais transforma qualquer um numa casca ressecada, pois esta lâmina cega absorve aos poucos todos os líquidos ao redor.
gear-weapon#0295.flat: Wielding it for too long will leave one a desiccated husk, as this dull blade slowly absorbs all liquids around it.

gear-weapon#0296.src: "As much as they're terrifying, at least those lousy skeletons give us lots of bonemeal for the crops!" -Bylvis, {p} Farmer
gear-weapon#0296.dst: "Por mais assustadores que sejam, pelo menos esses esqueletos miseráveis nos dão muita farinha de osso para as plantações!" -Bylvis, fazendeiro de {p}
gear-weapon#0296.flat: "As much as they're terrifying, at least those lousy skeletons give us lots of bonemeal for the crops!" -Bylvis, {p} Farmer
gear-weapon#0296._raw: "As much as they're terrifying, at least those lousy skeletons give us lots of bonemeal for the crops!" -Bylvis, Katoa Ranch Farmer

gear-weapon#0297.src: The average bow can boast a range of skills, but unlike this one, not every bow can penetrate through any organic skin, including dragon hide.
gear-weapon#0297.dst: Um arco comum pode ostentar várias qualidades, mas, ao contrário deste, nem todo arco consegue perfurar qualquer pele orgânica, inclusive couro de dragão.
gear-weapon#0297.flat: The average bow can boast a range of skills, but unlike this one, not every bow can penetrate through any organic skin, including dragon hide.

gear-weapon#0298.src: "Even a corrupted would get crushed by one of these!" -Roche 'Stone-thrower' Diamant, {p} Citizen
gear-weapon#0298.dst: "Até um corrompido seria esmagado por um desses!" -Roche 'Atira-pedras' Diamant, cidadão de {p}
gear-weapon#0298.flat: "Even a corrupted would get crushed by one of these!" -Roche 'Stone-thrower' Diamant, {p} Citizen
gear-weapon#0298._raw: "Even a corrupted would get crushed by one of these!" -Roche 'Stone-thrower' Diamant, Ragni Citizen

gear-weapon#0299.src: Launch into the heavens, then descend with the fury of a raging storm. Drag the sky down with you, and shatter it upon the earth in a devastating torrent of wind.
gear-weapon#0299.dst: Lance-se aos céus e então desça com a fúria de uma tempestade violenta. Arraste o céu com você e despedace-o contra a terra numa torrente devastadora de vento.
gear-weapon#0299.flat: Launch into the heavens, then descend with the fury of a raging storm. Drag the sky down with you, and shatter it upon the earth in a devastating torrent of wind.

gear-weapon#0300.src: Abandon your fear. Look forward. Move forward and never stop. Retreat and you will age. Hesitate and you will die.
gear-weapon#0300.dst: Abandone o medo. Olhe para a frente. Siga em frente e nunca pare. Recue e você envelhecerá. Hesite e você morrerá.
gear-weapon#0300.flat: Abandon your fear. Look forward. Move forward and never stop. Retreat and you will age. Hesitate and you will die.

gear-weapon#0301.src: The spelling seems to have been botched.
gear-weapon#0301.dst: Parece que erraram feio na grafia.
gear-weapon#0301.flat: The spelling seems to have been botched.

gear-weapon#0302.src: Many who venture into the jungle are swallowed by the thick undergrowth and are never seen again. This weapon and an accompanying skeleton were found inside the very adversary the spear was meant to vanquish as a perfect display of its owner's untimely demise.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0302.dst: Muitos que se aventuram na selva são engolidos pela vegetação densa e nunca mais são vistos. Esta arma e um esqueleto que a acompanhava foram encontrados dentro do mesmo adversário que a lança deveria derrotar, uma demonstração perfeita da morte prematura de seu dono.Está puxando em direção a algo.
gear-weapon#0302.flat: Many who venture into the jungle are swallowed by the thick undergrowth and are never seen again. This weapon and an accompanying skeleton were found inside the very adversary the spear was meant to vanquish as a perfect display of its owner's untimely demise.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0303.src: "The sun and related symbols appear quite often in these ancient glyphs.  Interesting, but unsurprising, no?" -Svin, Legend Keeper
gear-weapon#0303.dst: "O sol e símbolos relacionados aparecem com muita frequência nestes glifos antigos.  Interessante, mas nada surpreendente, não?" -Svin, Guardião das Lendas
gear-weapon#0303.flat: "The sun and related symbols appear quite often in these ancient glyphs.  Interesting, but unsurprising, no?" -Svin, Legend Keeper

gear-weapon#0304.src: It is an apathy born from lonely desperation with which one sends a blinding ray as their signal flare, uncaring if it hails friend or foe.
gear-weapon#0304.dst: É uma apatia nascida do desespero solitário que leva alguém a disparar um raio ofuscante como sinalizador, sem se importar se ele chamará amigo ou inimigo.
gear-weapon#0304.flat: It is an apathy born from lonely desperation with which one sends a blinding ray as their signal flare, uncaring if it hails friend or foe.

gear-weapon#0305.src: This pike carries an insatiable momentum. The blade darts through the air, slicing through the wind with a speed so great the air screams in protest, a roaring echo to be heard miles away.
gear-weapon#0305.dst: Este pique carrega um ímpeto insaciável. A lâmina dispara pelo ar, cortando o vento a uma velocidade tão grande que o ar grita em protesto, um eco estrondoso ouvido a quilômetros.
gear-weapon#0305.flat: This pike carries an insatiable momentum. The blade darts through the air, slicing through the wind with a speed so great the air screams in protest, a roaring echo to be heard miles away.

gear-weapon#0306.src: This bow's thick string fails to shoot arrows effectively, but instead produces low frequency sound waves that erupt from the source in all directions. The sound can implode the eardrums of an enemy with a single strum.
gear-weapon#0306.dst: A corda grossa deste arco não dispara flechas direito, mas produz ondas sonoras de baixa frequência que irrompem da fonte em todas as direções. O som pode estourar os tímpanos de um inimigo com um único dedilhar.
gear-weapon#0306.flat: This bow's thick string fails to shoot arrows effectively, but instead produces low frequency sound waves that erupt from the source in all directions. The sound can implode the eardrums of an enemy with a single strum.

gear-weapon#0307.src: Do you recognize the cries before you? Those so far beneath you, forgotten by time and betrayed by history. Hear their song- of asylum lost and vengeance unfulfilled. Bring them closure.
gear-weapon#0307.dst: Você reconhece os gritos à sua frente? Daqueles tão abaixo de você, esquecidos pelo tempo e traídos pela história. Ouça a canção deles, de um asilo perdido e de uma vingança não cumprida. Dê a eles um desfecho.
gear-weapon#0307.flat: Do you recognize the cries before you? Those so far beneath you, forgotten by time and betrayed by history. Hear their song- of asylum lost and vengeance unfulfilled. Bring them closure.

gear-weapon#0308.src: Recovered from the {p} Penitentiary, this grisly bow holds destructive capabilities. Used to carry out executions, a precise enough shot can shatter the soul of those it hits.
gear-weapon#0308.dst: Recuperado da Penitenciária de {p}, este arco macabro tem capacidades destrutivas. Usado em execuções, um disparo preciso o bastante pode estilhaçar a alma de quem é atingido.
gear-weapon#0308.flat: Recovered from the {p} Penitentiary, this grisly bow holds destructive capabilities. Used to carry out executions, a precise enough shot can shatter the soul of those it hits.
gear-weapon#0308._raw: Recovered from the Lexdale Penitentiary, this grisly bow holds destructive capabilities. Used to carry out executions, a precise enough shot can shatter the soul of those it hits.

gear-weapon#0309.src: Arrows fired by this bow are pure ice, but when they hit the enemy, burst into magical water, flash-freezing all that it touches. The frost burns will never heal.
gear-weapon#0309.dst: As flechas disparadas por este arco são de gelo puro, mas, ao atingir o inimigo, explodem em água mágica, congelando na hora tudo o que tocam. As queimaduras de frio nunca vão sarar.
gear-weapon#0309.flat: Arrows fired by this bow are pure ice, but when they hit the enemy, burst into magical water, flash-freezing all that it touches. The frost burns will never heal.

gear-weapon#0310.src: "The plants loathe to take hold upon the red stone. And so, we must hunt instead."  -Caras, Owl Tribesman
gear-weapon#0310.dst: "As plantas detestam se fixar na pedra vermelha. Então, precisamos caçar."  -Caras, membro da tribo Coruja
gear-weapon#0310.flat: "The plants loathe to take hold upon the red stone. And so, we must hunt instead."  -Caras, Owl Tribesman

gear-weapon#0311.src: The art of endurance fighting is a skill lost to time. However, a thief that to this day has not been caught, imbued this dagger with the very same ability.
gear-weapon#0311.dst: A arte de lutar com resistência é uma habilidade perdida no tempo. Porém, um ladrão que até hoje não foi pego imbuiu esta adaga exatamente com essa capacidade.
gear-weapon#0311.flat: The art of endurance fighting is a skill lost to time. However, a thief that to this day has not been caught, imbued this dagger with the very same ability.

gear-weapon#0312.src: "There's never new water flowing into those sewers. It all cycles back into itself...not natural." -Jenprest, {p} Legion {~}nd Division
gear-weapon#0312.dst: "Nunca entra água nova nesses esgotos. Ela fica circulando sobre si mesma... não é natural." -Jenprest, {~}ª Divisão da Legião de {p}
gear-weapon#0312.flat: "There's never new water flowing into those sewers. It all cycles back into itself...not natural." -Jenprest, {p} Legion {~}nd Division
gear-weapon#0312._raw: "There's never new water flowing into those sewers. It all cycles back into itself...not natural." -Jenprest, Ragni Legion 2nd Division

gear-weapon#0313.src: From afar, a faint light glimmers. A brighter light next. Another. Then another still. A cascade of blinding force, more than anything you could have ever imagined. And then... nothing. As though there was never anything there.
gear-weapon#0313.dst: Ao longe, uma luz fraca cintila. Depois, uma luz mais forte. Outra. E mais outra. Uma cascata de força ofuscante, mais do que você jamais poderia imaginar. E então... nada. Como se nunca tivesse havido nada ali.
gear-weapon#0313.flat: From afar, a faint light glimmers. A brighter light next. Another. Then another still. A cascade of blinding force, more than anything you could have ever imagined. And then... nothing. As though there was never anything there.

gear-weapon#0314.src: Crafted exclusively by the Temple of the Legends' mages, this stave is honorary to Mages who best the Temple's Grand Magus.
gear-weapon#0314.dst: Feito exclusivamente pelos magos do Templo das Lendas, este bordão é uma honraria para os magos que vencem o Grande Mago do Templo.
gear-weapon#0314.flat: Crafted exclusively by the Temple of the Legends' mages, this stave is honorary to Mages who best the Temple's Grand Magus.

gear-weapon#0315.src: "I swear on my life those spiders were covered in spikes! Go out there, see if I'm wrong!" -Suri, Elemental Researcher
gear-weapon#0315.dst: "Juro pela minha vida que aquelas aranhas eram cobertas de espinhos! Vá lá fora e veja se estou errada!" -Suri, pesquisadora elemental
gear-weapon#0315.flat: "I swear on my life those spiders were covered in spikes! Go out there, see if I'm wrong!" -Suri, Elemental Researcher

gear-weapon#0316.src: If it weren't for that stray mark, this would be spelled correctly...
gear-weapon#0316.dst: Se não fosse por aquela marca perdida, isto estaria escrito certo...
gear-weapon#0316.flat: If it weren't for that stray mark, this would be spelled correctly...

gear-weapon#0317.src: Do you ... really expect to be able to steal, or even touch, a single drop from that holiest-and cruelest-of springs?
gear-weapon#0317.dst: Você ... espera mesmo conseguir roubar, ou sequer tocar, uma única gota daquela fonte, a mais sagrada e a mais cruel de todas?
gear-weapon#0317.flat: Do you ... really expect to be able to steal, or even touch, a single drop from that holiest-and cruelest-of springs?

gear-weapon#0318.src: "Never wish to see a dead loved one again. In this day and age, they'll come back to see you." -Mylo, {p} Conscript
gear-weapon#0318.dst: "Nunca deseje ver de novo um ente querido morto. Nos dias de hoje, ele volta para ver você." -Mylo, recruta de {p}
gear-weapon#0318.flat: "Never wish to see a dead loved one again. In this day and age, they'll come back to see you." -Mylo, {p} Conscript
gear-weapon#0318._raw: "Never wish to see a dead loved one again. In this day and age, they'll come back to see you." -Mylo, Nemract Conscript

gear-weapon#0319.src: Deep, deep below the swirling, suffocating muck and the things that slither and crawl in the dark, there is a pulse. A wild, churning, erratic pulse, beating ever so quickly to the tempo of the earth, waiting to be unleashed.
gear-weapon#0319.dst: Lá no fundo, bem abaixo da lama rodopiante e sufocante e das coisas que rastejam e se arrastam no escuro, há um pulso. Um pulso selvagem, agitado e errático, batendo muito rápido no compasso da terra, esperando para ser libertado.
gear-weapon#0319.flat: Deep, deep below the swirling, suffocating muck and the things that slither and crawl in the dark, there is a pulse. A wild, churning, erratic pulse, beating ever so quickly to the tempo of the earth, waiting to be unleashed.

gear-weapon#0320.src: Its frame is as that of a horrid maw, its arrows hideous tongues of stone. They reach out, pulling their victims into an acidic embrace. What are they searching, grasping for? Perhaps some questions are wiser to ignore.
gear-weapon#0320.dst: Sua estrutura é como uma bocarra horrenda, e suas flechas, línguas de pedra medonhas. Elas se estendem, puxando as vítimas para um abraço ácido. O que procuram, o que tentam agarrar? Talvez seja mais sensato ignorar certas perguntas.
gear-weapon#0320.flat: Its frame is as that of a horrid maw, its arrows hideous tongues of stone. They reach out, pulling their victims into an acidic embrace. What are they searching, grasping for? Perhaps some questions are wiser to ignore.

gear-weapon#0321.src: Once known as the Doomsday Weapon, it was ultimately never used for its intended purpose - its solar focus was cracked upon the day of its completion. All but a fraction of its energy was expelled, obliterating its creators, but overwhelming magical force still pulses and thrums through the web of fractures in its design.
gear-weapon#0321.dst: Outrora conhecida como a Arma do Juízo Final, ela nunca chegou a ser usada para seu propósito: seu foco solar rachou no dia em que ficou pronta. Quase toda a sua energia foi expelida, aniquilando os criadores, mas uma força mágica avassaladora ainda pulsa e vibra pela teia de fraturas de seu projeto.
gear-weapon#0321.flat: Once known as the Doomsday Weapon, it was ultimately never used for its intended purpose - its solar focus was cracked upon the day of its completion. All but a fraction of its energy was expelled, obliterating its creators, but overwhelming magical force still pulses and thrums through the web of fractures in its design.

gear-weapon#0322.src: An attempt to rule with an iron fist, a power hellbent on control and force.  Unknown. How far does the indomitable spirit of humanity extend?
gear-weapon#0322.dst: Uma tentativa de governar com mão de ferro, um poder obcecado por controle e força.  Desconhecido. Até onde vai o espírito indomável da humanidade?
gear-weapon#0322.flat: An attempt to rule with an iron fist, a power hellbent on control and force.  Unknown. How far does the indomitable spirit of humanity extend?

gear-weapon#0323.src: No one can hold you down anymore.
gear-weapon#0323.flat: No one can hold you down anymore.

gear-weapon#0324.src: The soul of a Devil is so hot with hatred that their  bodies melt like candle wax, coming off in molten globs of flesh until only black bones remain.
gear-weapon#0324.dst: A alma de um Diabo arde tanto de ódio que seu  corpo derrete como cera de vela, soltando-se em bolotas de carne derretida até restarem só ossos negros.
gear-weapon#0324.flat: The soul of a Devil is so hot with hatred that their  bodies melt like candle wax, coming off in molten globs of flesh until only black bones remain.

gear-weapon#0325.src: You will probably irreversibly harm yourself with this, but when has that ever stopped you?
gear-weapon#0325.dst: Você provavelmente vai se machucar de forma irreversível com isto, mas desde quando isso impediu você?
gear-weapon#0325.flat: You will probably irreversibly harm yourself with this, but when has that ever stopped you?

gear-weapon#0326.src: This spear comes alive in your hands. It whispers strategy and technique to you, a voice that cuts through the clash of metal and screams of the dying. It is always correct. It has only ever lost a single battle. Do not let it down.
gear-weapon#0326.dst: Esta lança ganha vida em suas mãos. Ela sussurra estratégia e técnica, uma voz que atravessa o choque do metal e os gritos dos moribundos. Está sempre certa. Só perdeu uma única batalha. Não a decepcione.
gear-weapon#0326.flat: This spear comes alive in your hands. It whispers strategy and technique to you, a voice that cuts through the clash of metal and screams of the dying. It is always correct. It has only ever lost a single battle. Do not let it down.

gear-weapon#0328.src: The stones have a language. You can learn to direct their shiftings and discover their names; all you must do in return is forget your own.
gear-weapon#0328.dst: As pedras têm uma língua. Você pode aprender a dirigir seus movimentos e descobrir seus nomes; em troca, só precisa esquecer o seu.
gear-weapon#0328.flat: The stones have a language. You can learn to direct their shiftings and discover their names; all you must do in return is forget your own.

gear-weapon#0329.src: Presto. Like a viper's strike, retreating before the prey even feels the fang. A blade defined by a speed that leaves no memory of its passing.
gear-weapon#0329.dst: Presto. Como o bote de uma víbora, que recua antes que a presa sequer sinta a presa. Uma lâmina definida por uma velocidade que não deixa lembrança de sua passagem.
gear-weapon#0329.flat: Presto. Like a viper's strike, retreating before the prey even feels the fang. A blade defined by a speed that leaves no memory of its passing.

gear-weapon#0330.src: Moderato. Like the disciplined steps of a march, never skipping its appointed mark. A wand defined by a constancy that brings order to chaos.
gear-weapon#0330.dst: Moderato. Como os passos disciplinados de uma marcha, que nunca pulam o compasso. Uma varinha definida por uma constância que põe ordem no caos.
gear-weapon#0330.flat: Moderato. Like the disciplined steps of a march, never skipping its appointed mark. A wand defined by a constancy that brings order to chaos.

gear-weapon#0331.src: Adagio. Like the heavy hammer of a blacksmith, striking slow to shape tempered steel. A crossbow defined by the deliberate power of its draw.
gear-weapon#0331.dst: Adagio. Como o martelo pesado de um ferreiro, que bate devagar para moldar o aço temperado. Uma besta definida pela força deliberada de sua puxada.
gear-weapon#0331.flat: Adagio. Like the heavy hammer of a blacksmith, striking slow to shape tempered steel. A crossbow defined by the deliberate power of its draw.

gear-weapon#0332.src: Largo. Like the deep ocean tides governed by the moon, indifferent to the hurry of the world. A spear defined by a crushing momentum that nothing can halt.
gear-weapon#0332.dst: Largo. Como as marés profundas do oceano governadas pela lua, indiferentes à pressa do mundo. Uma lança definida por um ímpeto esmagador que nada pode deter.
gear-weapon#0332.flat: Largo. Like the deep ocean tides governed by the moon, indifferent to the hurry of the world. A spear defined by a crushing momentum that nothing can halt.

gear-weapon#0333.src: No eyes see past the dark fog that enshrouds the future. But if you could perhaps light the way, what would you see? Invigorating hope? Or a warning to be heeded?
gear-weapon#0333.dst: Nenhum olho enxerga além da névoa escura que envolve o futuro. Mas se você pudesse iluminar o caminho, o que veria? Uma esperança revigorante? Ou um aviso a ser levado a sério?
gear-weapon#0333.flat: No eyes see past the dark fog that enshrouds the future. But if you could perhaps light the way, what would you see? Invigorating hope? Or a warning to be heeded?

gear-weapon#0334.src: I'm not touching this with a... well. Yeah.
gear-weapon#0334.dst: Eu não tocaria nisso nem com uma... bom. É.
gear-weapon#0334.flat: I'm not touching this with a... well. Yeah.

gear-weapon#0335.src: The strength to keep going, to push on in the face of adversity. It's a rare kind of grit, the one that takes hold and won't let go until the task is done.
gear-weapon#0335.dst: A força para continuar, para seguir em frente diante da adversidade. É um tipo raro de garra, daquela que agarra e não solta até a tarefa estar feita.
gear-weapon#0335.flat: The strength to keep going, to push on in the face of adversity. It's a rare kind of grit, the one that takes hold and won't let go until the task is done.

gear-weapon#0336.src: Don't give them time for even a warning.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0336.dst: Não dê a eles tempo nem para um aviso.Está puxando em direção a algo.
gear-weapon#0336.flat: Don't give them time for even a warning.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0337.src: Forged from unbreakable obsidian eras ago, this heavy hammer has crushed many foes with a single swing.
gear-weapon#0337.dst: Forjado em obsidiana inquebrável há eras, este martelo pesado já esmagou muitos inimigos com um só golpe.
gear-weapon#0337.flat: Forged from unbreakable obsidian eras ago, this heavy hammer has crushed many foes with a single swing.

gear-weapon#0338.src: Once having held unstoppable amounts of magic, being forced to fuse into one form locked away all but the smallest sliver of their power.
gear-weapon#0338.dst: Depois de conter quantidades imparáveis de magia, serem forçados a se fundir numa só forma trancou todo o seu poder, menos uma lasca minúscula.
gear-weapon#0338.flat: Once having held unstoppable amounts of magic, being forced to fuse into one form locked away all but the smallest sliver of their power.

gear-weapon#0339.src: "How perfect can a form be? The creatures here are warped. Distorted. their flesh bubbles and oozes with the most toxic of acids. But it makes them powerful. Resilient. Perhaps it would be better to become one of them. Perhaps it would make your form . . . perfect."
gear-weapon#0339.dst: "Quão perfeita pode ser uma forma? As criaturas daqui são deformadas. Distorcidas. A carne delas borbulha e escorre os ácidos mais tóxicos. Mas isso as torna poderosas. Resistentes. Talvez fosse melhor se tornar uma delas. Talvez isso deixasse sua forma . . . perfeita."
gear-weapon#0339.flat: "How perfect can a form be? The creatures here are warped. Distorted. their flesh bubbles and oozes with the most toxic of acids. But it makes them powerful. Resilient. Perhaps it would be better to become one of them. Perhaps it would make your form . . . perfect."

gear-weapon#0340.src: This indestructible dagger was found floating in the magma of the {p}, with a lament from its exiled smith carved onto the hilt.
gear-weapon#0340.dst: Esta adaga indestrutível foi encontrada boiando no magma de {p}, com um lamento de seu ferreiro exilado gravado no cabo.
gear-weapon#0340.flat: This indestructible dagger was found floating in the magma of the {p}, with a lament from its exiled smith carved onto the hilt.
gear-weapon#0340._raw: This indestructible dagger was found floating in the magma of the Molten Heights, with a lament from its exiled smith carved onto the hilt.

gear-weapon#0341.src: "They tear the earth open day after day after day, ripping out her most precious and vital stones, and dumping them into the abyss of their hungry, bottomless coffers. They would sell out the world for a bit of cash; after all, these stones bleed green."
gear-weapon#0341.dst: "Eles abrem a terra dia após dia após dia, arrancando as pedras mais preciosas e vitais dela e jogando-as no abismo de seus cofres famintos e sem fundo. Venderiam o mundo por um pouco de dinheiro; afinal, estas pedras sangram verde."
gear-weapon#0341.flat: "They tear the earth open day after day after day, ripping out her most precious and vital stones, and dumping them into the abyss of their hungry, bottomless coffers. They would sell out the world for a bit of cash; after all, these stones bleed green."

gear-weapon#0342.src: "In the days before they ripped out its heart, there was a pulse to these streets: the sanguine flow of life through the sturdy buildings and cobbled roads and hidden alleys. What remains is a bloodless husk, dusty walls populated solely by those hideous things which can only see and never know."
gear-weapon#0342.dst: "Nos dias antes de arrancarem seu coração, havia pulso nestas ruas: o fluxo sanguíneo da vida pelos prédios sólidos, pelas ruas de pedra e pelos becos escondidos. O que resta é uma casca sem sangue, muros empoeirados habitados apenas por aquelas coisas horrendas que só conseguem ver e nunca saber."
gear-weapon#0342.flat: "In the days before they ripped out its heart, there was a pulse to these streets: the sanguine flow of life through the sturdy buildings and cobbled roads and hidden alleys. What remains is a bloodless husk, dusty walls populated solely by those hideous things which can only see and never know."

gear-weapon#0343.src: After eons spent in parochial search for something familiar, perhaps this blade should have been a hint to think outside the box.
gear-weapon#0343.dst: Depois de eras numa busca tacanha por algo familiar, talvez esta lâmina devesse ter sido uma dica para pensar fora da caixa.
gear-weapon#0343.flat: After eons spent in parochial search for something familiar, perhaps this blade should have been a hint to think outside the box.

gear-weapon#0345.src: The ocean's bounty is full of many strange things. Sailor's tales of a peculiar fish with a snout like a sword and the unbelievable stories of its power thus inspired fanciful ideas in blacksmiths. The results speak for themselves.
gear-weapon#0345.dst: A fartura do oceano está cheia de coisas estranhas. Histórias de marinheiros sobre um peixe peculiar com um focinho que parecia uma espada, e os relatos inacreditáveis de seu poder, inspiraram ideias fantasiosas nos ferreiros. Os resultados falam por si.
gear-weapon#0345.flat: The ocean's bounty is full of many strange things. Sailor's tales of a peculiar fish with a snout like a sword and the unbelievable stories of its power thus inspired fanciful ideas in blacksmiths. The results speak for themselves.

gear-weapon#0346.src: "The feeling begins as a prickle on the neck. Is that tree staring? What does it see? How much does it know? This place is not right. It sees too much. It knows too much. The forest is staring at you. It burns the secrets out of you through its awful, unnatural retinas. There is nowhere to hide."
gear-weapon#0346.dst: "A sensação começa como um arrepio na nuca. Aquela árvore está encarando? O que ela vê? Quanto ela sabe? Este lugar não está certo. Ele vê demais. Sabe demais. A floresta está encarando você. Ela arranca seus segredos a fogo com aquelas retinas horríveis e antinaturais. Não há onde se esconder."
gear-weapon#0346.flat: "The feeling begins as a prickle on the neck. Is that tree staring? What does it see? How much does it know? This place is not right. It sees too much. It knows too much. The forest is staring at you. It burns the secrets out of you through its awful, unnatural retinas. There is nowhere to hide."

gear-weapon#0347.src: "And no one's going to save us from the beasts about to strike. We've seen horrors stare us in the eyes, and we're fighting for our lives." -Poe, {p} Sewer Dweller
gear-weapon#0347.dst: "E ninguém vai nos salvar das feras prestes a atacar. Vimos horrores nos encarando nos olhos, e estamos lutando pela vida." -Poe, morador dos esgotos de {p}
gear-weapon#0347.flat: "And no one's going to save us from the beasts about to strike. We've seen horrors stare us in the eyes, and we're fighting for our lives." -Poe, {p} Sewer Dweller
gear-weapon#0347._raw: "And no one's going to save us from the beasts about to strike. We've seen horrors stare us in the eyes, and we're fighting for our lives." -Poe, Nemract Sewer Dweller

gear-weapon#0348.src: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and consuming fury combine to create a deadly aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for utter cataclysm.
gear-weapon#0348.dst: O poder combinado das runas Uth inscritas e de uma fúria devoradora cria uma aura mortal, pois esta arma não passa de uma extensão espiritual do desejo do usuário por um cataclismo absoluto.
gear-weapon#0348.flat: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and consuming fury combine to create a deadly aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for utter cataclysm.

gear-weapon#0349.src: The raw aspect of thunder, though claimed to be harnessed by a mage in a wand, has only been truly tamed by this mighty blade. Combined electric and life-draining magic intertwine and bring forth the truest, most frightening power of all Thunder.
gear-weapon#0349.dst: O aspecto bruto do trovão, embora um mago diga tê-lo dominado numa varinha, só foi de fato domado por esta poderosa lâmina. A magia elétrica e a que drena a vida se entrelaçam e trazem à tona o poder mais verdadeiro e assustador de todo o Trovão.
gear-weapon#0349.flat: The raw aspect of thunder, though claimed to be harnessed by a mage in a wand, has only been truly tamed by this mighty blade. Combined electric and life-draining magic intertwine and bring forth the truest, most frightening power of all Thunder.

gear-weapon#0350.src: This bow has no string. Instead, a thin lightning-like thread is strung upon it. It is said to be limited only by the speed of the user.
gear-weapon#0350.dst: Este arco não tem corda. No lugar dela, há um fio fino, parecido com um relâmpago. Dizem que ele só é limitado pela velocidade do usuário.
gear-weapon#0350.flat: This bow has no string. Instead, a thin lightning-like thread is strung upon it. It is said to be limited only by the speed of the user.

gear-weapon#0351.src: This mysterious, half-liquid trident apparently holds the secret magics to control the ocean's ebb and flow. It is incapable of touching solid ground.
gear-weapon#0351.dst: Este misterioso tridente meio líquido parece guardar as magias secretas para controlar o fluxo e o refluxo do oceano. Ele é incapaz de tocar terra firme.
gear-weapon#0351.flat: This mysterious, half-liquid trident apparently holds the secret magics to control the ocean's ebb and flow. It is incapable of touching solid ground.

gear-weapon#0352.src: The wear upon this broken old battle spear does not affect its ability in battle. The souls of a thousand fallen warriors resound within it.
gear-weapon#0352.dst: O desgaste desta velha lança de batalha quebrada não afeta sua capacidade em combate. As almas de mil guerreiros caídos ressoam dentro dela.
gear-weapon#0352.flat: The wear upon this broken old battle spear does not affect its ability in battle. The souls of a thousand fallen warriors resound within it.

gear-weapon#0353.src: This peculiar weapon was once wielded by the firey warrior Igbar, who used it to great effect in endurance competitions.
gear-weapon#0353.dst: Esta arma peculiar já foi empunhada pelo fogoso guerreiro Igbar, que a usou com grande sucesso em competições de resistência.
gear-weapon#0353.flat: This peculiar weapon was once wielded by the firey warrior Igbar, who used it to great effect in endurance competitions.

gear-weapon#0354.src: The tides of the ocean, once bound, became useful magic power sources. They were once utilized for weapons, but to harness the unstable force of the raging sea was considered too dangerous.
gear-weapon#0354.dst: As marés do oceano, uma vez contidas, viraram fontes úteis de poder mágico. Já foram usadas em armas, mas dominar a força instável do mar revolto foi considerado perigoso demais.
gear-weapon#0354.flat: The tides of the ocean, once bound, became useful magic power sources. They were once utilized for weapons, but to harness the unstable force of the raging sea was considered too dangerous.

gear-weapon#0355.src: A hissing, cracking harmony swells, a maddening chorus to blare across the broken plains, yet still: unseen and alive, it swells with the beat of the earth, still breathing, still killing.
gear-weapon#0355.dst: Uma harmonia sibilante e estalada cresce, um coro enlouquecedor que ressoa pelas planícies destroçadas, e ainda assim: invisível e viva, ela cresce com a batida da terra, ainda respirando, ainda matando.
gear-weapon#0355.flat: A hissing, cracking harmony swells, a maddening chorus to blare across the broken plains, yet still: unseen and alive, it swells with the beat of the earth, still breathing, still killing.

gear-weapon#0356.src: Can you feel the burning inside? Something has made itself at home. Time to tuck away the parts of you it has no need for, to shuffle your little brain around so you may Carry. Carry and Spread. Give it a new home-melting you down is how it says thank you. Be grateful, won't you?
gear-weapon#0356.dst: Sente o ardor aí dentro? Algo se instalou à vontade. Hora de guardar as partes de você de que ele não precisa, de reorganizar seu cerebrozinho para que você possa Carregar. Carregar e Espalhar. Dê a ele um novo lar: derreter você é o jeito dele de agradecer. Seja grato, sim?
gear-weapon#0356.flat: Can you feel the burning inside? Something has made itself at home. Time to tuck away the parts of you it has no need for, to shuffle your little brain around so you may Carry. Carry and Spread. Give it a new home-melting you down is how it says thank you. Be grateful, won't you?

gear-weapon#0357.src: Down. Your enemies will fall slack. Deeper. Do you know this compulsion you bring? Deeper still. This implement, reaching from within and without. Even deeper. Souls and wills to command at the flex of a finger. Almost gone. It is my compulsion, too great to ignore. It is my implement, too strong to resist. My puppets, too deep to escape. Drop.
gear-weapon#0357.dst: Abaixo. Seus inimigos vão amolecer. Mais fundo. Você conhece essa compulsão que traz? Mais fundo ainda. Este instrumento, que alcança por dentro e por fora. Ainda mais fundo. Almas e vontades a comandar com um mover de dedo. Quase lá. É a minha compulsão, grande demais para ignorar. É o meu instrumento, forte demais para resistir. Minhas marionetes, fundo demais para escapar. Caia.
gear-weapon#0357.flat: Down. Your enemies will fall slack. Deeper. Do you know this compulsion you bring? Deeper still. This implement, reaching from within and without. Even deeper. Souls and wills to command at the flex of a finger. Almost gone. It is my compulsion, too great to ignore. It is my implement, too strong to resist. My puppets, too deep to escape. Drop.

gear-weapon#0358.src: Desperation breeds creativity. What would it take to force your will upon the world? To bend and break and weave existence, to bypass the immutable? The result is different, wrong, anathema to your being... but it is freedom from the chains that bind you. It is enough.
gear-weapon#0358.dst: O desespero gera criatividade. O que seria preciso para impor sua vontade ao mundo? Para dobrar, quebrar e tecer a existência, para contornar o imutável? O resultado é diferente, errado, um anátema ao seu ser... mas é a liberdade das correntes que prendem você. Isso basta.
gear-weapon#0358.flat: Desperation breeds creativity. What would it take to force your will upon the world? To bend and break and weave existence, to bypass the immutable? The result is different, wrong, anathema to your being... but it is freedom from the chains that bind you. It is enough.

gear-weapon#0359.src: "It feels like all these "ancient" civilizations have better tech than we do nowadays."  -Knox, Corkus Immigrant and Sandstorm Vandals bandit
gear-weapon#0359.dst: "Parece que todas essas civilizações "antigas" têm tecnologia melhor que a nossa hoje em dia."  -Knox, imigrante de Corkus e bandido dos Vândalos da Tempestade de Areia
gear-weapon#0359.flat: "It feels like all these "ancient" civilizations have better tech than we do nowadays."  -Knox, Corkus Immigrant and Sandstorm Vandals bandit

gear-weapon#0360.src: Truth, bliss, emanation, guiding the path forward unto enlightenment.
gear-weapon#0360.dst: Verdade, êxtase, emanação, guiando o caminho adiante rumo à iluminação.
gear-weapon#0360.flat: Truth, bliss, emanation, guiding the path forward unto enlightenment.

gear-weapon#0361.src: The hands of destiny tighten and slacken without remorse, pulling hearts together only to push them apart in a relentless dance.
gear-weapon#0361.dst: As mãos do destino apertam e afrouxam sem remorso, unindo corações só para separá-los numa dança implacável.
gear-weapon#0361.flat: The hands of destiny tighten and slacken without remorse, pulling hearts together only to push them apart in a relentless dance.

gear-weapon#0362.src: It takes two voices to make harmony.
gear-weapon#0362.dst: São precisas duas vozes para fazer harmonia.
gear-weapon#0362.flat: It takes two voices to make harmony.

gear-weapon#0363.src: To drag into shadow. To stifle in darkness. Anything is possible with total, suffocating eclipse at your beck and call.
gear-weapon#0363.dst: Arrastar para a sombra. Sufocar na escuridão. Tudo é possível com um eclipse total e sufocante às suas ordens.
gear-weapon#0363.flat: To drag into shadow. To stifle in darkness. Anything is possible with total, suffocating eclipse at your beck and call.

gear-weapon#0364.src: Sometimes, wavers in the light reveal visions of fantastical places.  A window or portal rippled into existence for just a moment, then winked out by a breeze.
gear-weapon#0364.dst: Às vezes, tremores na luz revelam visões de lugares fantásticos.  Uma janela ou um portal que ondula até existir por um instante e depois se apaga com uma brisa.
gear-weapon#0364.flat: Sometimes, wavers in the light reveal visions of fantastical places.  A window or portal rippled into existence for just a moment, then winked out by a breeze.

gear-weapon#0365.src: It seems stronger at first glance, but upon closer inspection the blade is rather...soft?
gear-weapon#0365.dst: À primeira vista parece mais forte, mas, olhando de perto, a lâmina é meio... mole?
gear-weapon#0365.flat: It seems stronger at first glance, but upon closer inspection the blade is rather...soft?

gear-weapon#2814.src: Hashr returned with singleminded belief, determined to keep the howling winds at bay from a usurped throne. Yet the storms raged on. The awe of his countrymen festered to hatred, and the blessing of his predecessor withered to a curse, the desert sands naught but grains in an hourglass so cruelly fused shut.
gear-weapon#2814.dst: Hashr voltou com uma fé inabalável, decidido a manter os ventos uivantes longe de um trono usurpado. Mas as tempestades continuaram a rugir. A admiração de seus compatriotas apodreceu em ódio, e a bênção de seu predecessor murchou em maldição; as areias do deserto não passavam de grãos numa ampulheta cruelmente selada.

gear-weapon#2815.src: It is said that a lost tribe of the jungle sought to grow a tree of their own as they founded a settlement, commemorating each new year with a single band carved intricately into it's lowest-hanging branch. Even as a great storm uprooted the trunk, the tradition wore on until their quiet collapse, nearly six hundred bands telling the tale of a tribe that once was.
gear-weapon#2815.dst: Dizem que uma tribo perdida da selva quis cultivar uma árvore própria ao fundar seu povoado, celebrando cada ano novo com um anel entalhado com esmero em seu galho mais baixo. Mesmo quando uma grande tempestade arrancou o tronco, a tradição seguiu até o silencioso declínio da tribo: quase seiscentos anéis contando a história de uma tribo que já existiu.
